snippet.title: March 20: Faith or Foolishness?
snippet.description:
COVID-19 has tempted us to be fearful, but there's also the temptation to be foolish. Today, I address the difference between foolishness and faith. 

If you would like the to find more encouragement and support, email office@jubileestl.org to join one of our online community groups.
